us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories in the United States

articles.title: US jobless claims fall to 194,000, lowest since July
bullets: Initial unemployment claims dropped to 194,000 last week.
AP said the figure was the lowest in three months.
The report signaled layoffs remain historically low.

articles.title: AP-NORC poll finds voters prioritize costs and Iran over Trump fights
bullets: Voters want Congress focused on affordability and ending the Iran war.
Fewer respondents prioritized investigating or supporting Trump.
The poll comes days before the midterm elections.

articles.title: Jeffries says Democrats are close to winning the House
bullets: Hakeem Jeffries said Democrats are “on the verge” of House control.
The midterms will determine Congress for Trump’s remaining term.
Jeffries would be the first Black House speaker if elected.

articles.title: Voting-related ballot measures include new voter ID pushes
bullets: November ballots include measures targeting in-person and mail voting.
Some proposals mirror voting policies Trump has promoted nationally.
AP cited polling showing broad support for photo ID requirements.

articles.title: Trump heads to Iowa as GOP works to boost midterm turnout
bullets: Trump planned an Iowa rally for Senate candidate Ashley Hinson.
Hinson is balancing Trump’s endorsement with broader voter outreach.
Recent polling showed support among Trump skeptics remains important.

articles.title: Canada says Trump tariffs hurt Americans as US alleges interference
bullets: Prime Minister Mark Carney criticized US tariffs on Canadian goods.
The US Embassy alleged Canadian interference in American politics.
The dispute followed tensions over autos, trade and election-related claims.

articles.title: Zelenskyy urges support for US Russia sanctions put on hold by Trump
bullets: Zelenskyy criticized the delay while avoiding direct attacks on Trump.
Ukraine reported intercepting Russian missiles and many attack drones.
Romania said it downed two drones over Black Sea waters.

articles.title: Mexico asks World Court to halt imminent US executions of five citizens
bullets: Mexico sought urgent World Court action over five death-row cases.
Reuters reported Mexico cited denied consular-assistance rights.
The filing targeted executions described as imminent.

articles.title: Iran war keeps global energy markets on edge
bullets: Oil prices remained volatile amid uncertainty over the Iran war.
AP reported Brent crude swung between $108 and $111.
Energy supply concerns continued affecting global markets.

articles.title: AP publishes top global news photos from October 21
bullets: AP’s photo editors selected standout images from global coverage.
The gallery included front-page news and major visual moments.
It captured world events from the preceding day.

articles.title: Rubio and Jaishankar hold Mumbai talks on trade and energy
bullets: Marco Rubio met Subrahmanyam Jaishankar in Mumbai.
Both sides said a trade deal was nearing completion.
The talks covered trade, energy, technology and defense.

articles.title: Rubio visits Ambani’s Jamnagar refinery amid US energy push
bullets: Rubio’s India itinerary included Reliance’s Jamnagar refining complex.
Washington wants deeper energy cooperation with India.
The visit followed talks on Russian oil and US exports.

articles.title: Delhi air quality deterioration draws fresh attention in October
bullets: Indian Express highlighted why Delhi’s air worsens in October.
Seasonal weather patterns and pollution sources were central factors.
Air quality remained a recurring public-health concern.

articles.title: India’s Asian Para Games medal tally reaches 35
bullets: India reached 35 medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games.
The tally included nine gold, 11 silver and 15 bronze medals.
Akashvani figures were cited in Indian school-news roundups.

articles.title: Indian states seek extra electricity amid supply shortfall concerns
bullets: Reports cited states seeking additional electricity supplies.
A September shortfall of 560 million units was reported.
Power availability remained a live issue before peak demand periods.

articles.title: SpaceX jumps after stronger profit report lifts Wall Street
bullets: SpaceX climbed 7.8% after beating summer profit expectations.
The S&P 500 gained 0.6% on Wednesday.
Tesla rose 3.4% amid merger-consideration comments.

articles.title: Super Micro rallies on stronger AI-server revenue outlook
bullets: Super Micro Computer raised its summer revenue expectations.
The company cited increased demand for AI platforms.
AP reported the stock rallied 9.5%.

articles.title: Netflix drops despite stronger profit as growth outlook disappoints
bullets: Netflix fell 5.3% after its earnings report.
Investors focused on weaker fourth-quarter revenue-growth expectations.
The move weighed on broader market sentiment.

articles.title: AT&T falls after guidance misses some investor expectations
bullets: AT&T fell 6.4% despite reporting stronger profit.
Its forecast for underlying earnings growth disappointed some analysts.
The stock was among Wednesday’s notable losers.

articles.title: Nvidia gains as AI trade steadies after recent volatility
bullets: Nvidia rose 2.5% and helped lift the S&P 500.
AI-linked shares remained volatile around borrowing-cost concerns.
Chip strength supported the Nasdaq’s 1.1% gain.

articles.title: US stock market rises near record on strong corporate earnings
bullets: The S&P 500 closed within 0.8% of its all-time high.
The Dow gained 360 points on Wednesday.
Corporate earnings from major companies helped lift sentiment.

articles.title: Capital One rises after profit beats expectations
bullets: Capital One Financial reported stronger-than-expected summer profit.
AP said the stock rose 2.5%.
Financial-sector earnings contributed to Wall Street’s gains.

articles.title: Winnebago surges on resilient profit despite fuel-price pressures
bullets: Winnebago rose 10.7% after beating profit expectations.
The company said lower-priced offerings attracted customers.
High fuel prices continued weighing on RV demand.

articles.title: GM says AI could halve vehicle design time
bullets: General Motors said it was using AI in vehicle design.
The goal is cutting new-model design time to about two years.
Reuters listed the item in a New York Times business digest.
articles.source: Reuters / New York Times digest via Tiger Brokers

articles.title: Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $25 billion in privacy case
bullets: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion.
A jury found Meta misled consumers about data privacy.
Reuters cited it as among major US business-page stories.
articles.source: Reuters / New York Times digest via Tiger Brokers

articles.title: Tech giants offer communities more money to host data centers
bullets: AP reported growing local pushback against large data centers.
Companies promised fewer secrets and more community payments.
Meta and Amazon each announced $1 billion incentive plans.

articles.title: AI infrastructure spending keeps driving market volatility
bullets: AP said AI stocks remain unsettled after years of gains.
Borrowing costs raised questions about data-center buildout spending.
Nvidia and Super Micro moved higher on Wednesday.

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla explore potential merger, Musk says
bullets: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla were exploring a merger.
The combination would unite rockets, EVs and AI interests.
Reuters cited the story in a business press digest.
articles.source: Reuters / New York Times digest via Tiger Brokers

articles.title: Bank of America hires contractors to patch AI-flagged software flaws
bullets: Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors for software patching.
The flaws were reportedly identified by Anthropic’s Mythos system.
CEO Brian Moynihan described the issues as real risk.

articles.title: AP technology briefing highlights AI and online privacy lawsuits
bullets: AP’s technology summary tracked lawsuits against major tech companies.
Privacy and children’s safety were central concerns.
The cases targeted AI chatbots and social-media platforms.
